title: Capital Development Authority Fourth Amendment Ordinance 1996

sections.shortTitle: Capital Development Authority Fourth Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CXVI OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXVI OF 1996
CAPITAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(FOURTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend tine
Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan; Extraordinary,
Part I, 12th December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 12‑12‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960 (XXIII of 1960), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Capital Development Authority (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It
shall come into‑force at once.

And whereas the National Assembly is

Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2, Ordinance
XXIII of 1960.‑‑In
the Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960 (XXIII of 1960), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2,‑‑
(a) in clause (k), in sub‑clause
(i), the word "and" at the end, occurring for the second time, shall
be omitted;
(b) in sub‑clause (ii), for
the full‑stop at the end a semi‑colon and word "and" shall
be substituted and thereafter the following new sub‑clause shall be
added, namely:‑‑
"(iii) in relation to land
acquired on or after the first day of January, 1996, the market value as may be
determined in accordance with the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
applicable in the Province of the Punjab. ".
